financialSettings.configurationRequiredSubheading: The following required financial settings must be configured before operational postings can execute:
financialSettings.defaultsDesc: Configure core and conditional General Ledger accounts across sales, purchasing, inventory, taxation, and treasury.
financialSettings.domainFxDesc: Realised gain/loss accounts on settlement and unrealised accounts for periodic revaluation.
financialSettings.domainGeneralLedgerDesc: System suspense account for unmapped balance balancing and default retained earnings account.
financialSettings.domainInventoryDesc: Perpetual stock valuation, goods receipt accrual clearing, and variance write-offs.
financialSettings.domainPosDesc: Clearing accounts for trade counter cash drawers and EFTPOS card terminals.
financialSettings.domainPurchasingDesc: Control and fallback accounts for vendor bills, purchasing expenses, and price variance.
financialSettings.domainSalesDesc: Control and fallback accounts for customer quotes, sales orders, invoicing, and revenue recognition.
financialSettings.domainTaxDesc: GL balance sheet accounts for output sales tax liabilities and input purchase tax credits.
financialSettings.impactAp: Required for vendor bills and payables posting.
financialSettings.impactAr: Required for customer invoices and receivables posting.
financialSettings.impactBaseCurrency: Required for foreign currency exchange rates and ledger consolidation.
financialSettings.impactCogs: Required for cost of goods sold on order dispatch.
financialSettings.impactCustomerTaxPosition: Required for domestic and export fiscal position rules for customers.
financialSettings.impactCustomerTerms: Required as fallback payment terms when creating customers and sales orders.
financialSettings.impactExpense: Required for vendor expense line posting.
financialSettings.impactGrni: Required for goods received accrual clearing.
financialSettings.impactInventory: Required for perpetual inventory valuation and goods receipts.
financialSettings.impactPurchaseTax: Required for purchase tax input credit postings.
financialSettings.impactPurchaseTaxCategory: Required for default deductible tax on purchase orders and bills.
financialSettings.impactRetainedEarnings: Required for year-end closing, retained earnings, and equity roll-forward.
financialSettings.impactRevenue: Required for sales invoice revenue recognition.
financialSettings.impactSalesTax: Required for sales tax output liability postings.
financialSettings.impactSalesTaxCategory: Required for default tax calculation on sales orders and invoices.
financialSettings.impactShrinkage: Required for stock adjustment write-offs and variance.
financialSettings.impactSupplierTaxPosition: Required for vendor tax position rule evaluation.
financialSettings.impactSupplierTerms: Required as fallback payment terms when creating suppliers and purchase orders.
financialSettings.impactSuspense: Required for initial imports, suspense postings, and unmapped account fallbacks.
financialSettings.subtitle: Manage core GL control accounts, chart of accounts hierarchy, trading terms, multi-currency rates, and tax positions
financialSettings.title: Financial Settings
